title: sales-partnership-scratch-notes-ryan
content:
Quick scratchpad for partnership/outbound. informal notes to self - keep short.

Top targets (initial focus):
1) Acme Health (healthcare/clinical alerts)
   - Why them: heavy real-time triage workflows, very sensitive to latency and data isolation. Use-case: summarize incoming clinical notes, triage alerts, embed search for past cases.
   - Key contacts: Kara Nguyen (Head of AI) - LinkedIn: /in/karanguyen; CTO: Miguel Sousa (miguel@acmehealth.com).
   - Signals: just raised Series D (press release Sept 2025), hiring ml infra, looking for HIPAA-ready vendor.
   - Why Redwood fits: private deployment options (VPC + on-prem), KMS/HSM support, predictable latency for live triage.
   - Possible objections: security/compliance audits, procurement timeline, long onboarding.
   - Objection counters: offer pilot on Redwood Private with audit support + reference checklist (audit pack). Propose 8-week pilot scope: 1 model + secure ingest + basic eval harness.

2) Nimbus Analytics (adtech/real-time personalization)
   - Why them: high qps, cost-sensitive, want embeddings for personalized recs + reranking.
   - Contact: Serena Ortiz (Lead Eng) - serena@nimbus.ai ; BD: Rahul Kapoor.
   - Signals: running multi-cloud infra, recent blog on cost-per-request.
   - Why Redwood fits: batching/auto-caching + quantization recs (Optimize) to reduce per-token cost; Dedicated for predictable throughput.
   - Objections: worried about vendor lock and pricing variability.
   - Counter: show cost model with batching + dedicated commit examples; we can supply per-route quotas and rollback policies.

3) AtlasBank (fintech / fraud detection)
   - Why them: regulatory and throughput constraints; need private deployments + audit trails; model eval and rollouts important.
   - Contact: Priya Mehta (SecOps) - priya.mehta@atlasbank.com; Product: Omar Ali.
   - Signals: banking client list on their site, RFPs expected Q1 2026.
   - Redwood value: Private + Dedicated options, tracing, auditable rollouts and canary policies.

Outreach templates (short, A/B test these)
A) Cold email - short, tailored
Subject: quick note - inference performance for (Acme Health)
Hi Kara - saw Acme's recent Series D - congrats. We've helped healthcare teams run clinical NLP at 10-20ms/token with VPC/private deployments and audit packs for HIPAA reviews. Would you be open to a 20-min intro to see if a short pilot makes sense?
- Ryan (Redwood)

B) LinkedIn DM (conversational)
Hi Kara - congrats on Acme's growth. I work on helping infra/AI teams ship inference reliably (low latency, private deployments). Happy to share a short pilot plan if you're exploring vendors.

Cold call / discovery script (30-40s open)
- Quick intro: Ryan from Redwood Inference. We help teams run LLMs at predictable latency/cost across hosted/dedicated/private deployments.
- Ask: "What's your biggest blocker for rolling LLMs into prod today - cost, latency, private infra, or eval/regulatory risk?"
- If latency/cost: share 2 metrics (example: 40% per-token savings with caching+quantization on customer X; 99th percentile latency 75ms for 1k token models on Dedicated).
- If compliance/regulatory: offer Private pilot + audit pack and SSO/KMS details.

Objection handling (short bullets)
- "We already have an in-house stack": ask about unit economics + maintenance headcount; offer 6-8 week side-by-side pilot metric comparison.
- "Vendor lock / portability": highlight model versioning, canary rollback, and supporting open models + exportable cache.
- "Pricing unpredictable": show Dedicated reserved examples + Optimize recommendations that include batching profiles and estimated $/1M tokens.

Metrics / soundbites to use
- "Predictable p99 latency guarantees with Dedicated pools."
- "Reduce inference unit cost by 30-60% using caching + optimized kernels + quantization guidance."
- "Private deployment with KMS/HSM and audit pack for regulated environments."

Case refs / social proof (internal names)
- MedTech pilot (NDA) - reduced per-token cost by ~45% after caching + quantization; 99th pctl latency under 150ms.
- Fintech pilot (reference: internal case ATLAS-PILOT) - audit pack + private deployment outcome positive.

Next steps checklist (to track per-account)
- [ ] Confirm primary contact + intro email thread (cc BD/Procurement).
- [ ] Schedule 20-min discovery call (add agenda: goals, constraints, timeline).
- [ ] Draft pilot SOW (8 weeks / 1 model / eval prompts) - template: github:repo/redwood-partner-templates.
- [ ] Run internal feasibility (SRE + infra) to map data ingress options (VPC, S3, on-prem).
- [ ] Prepare pricing/commit examples (hosted vs dedicated vs private).

Notes to self / process reminders
- Split outreach into Account Exec (warm intro) vs SDR (cold). Track response rates by template A vs B.
- Use CS-1245 for pilot SOW and link to finance pricing sheet before sending.
- Coordinate with Priya (legal) for HIPAA checklist for Acme Health.
- Marcus to share dedicated capacity case study for Nimbus outreach.

Random fragments / ideas to iterate later
- Create a short one-pager "Redwood for Healthcare" with HIPAA checklist + pilot steps.
- Quick ROI calculator for customers: inputs = qps, avg tokens/call, target latency; outputs = estimated $/month (hosted vs dedicated) and suggested config.
- Add a canned comparison slide: Redwood vs big cloud endpoints vs self-hosted open-source stack (ops cost, latency, compliance).

Links / refs to grab before outreach
- Confluence: PARTNERS-142 (partner pilot template)
- Pricing sheet: drive:shared_drives/go-to-market/pricing/redwood-pricing-2025.xlsx
- Internal case study: ATLAS-PILOT (ask Marcus)

End notes: keep this doc very lightweight. Move actionable items into the CRM (HubSpot) and link back here. Update status when outreach starts.
